summary.en-US: Open the current Firefox tab in Google Chrome with one click. Windows helper required. No tracking.

description.en-US:
One click. Your tab in Chrome.

Chrome Hop opens the current HTTP or HTTPS page in your installed Google Chrome on Windows 11, keeping your Firefox tab open. Pin the button to your Firefox toolbar and click it when you want to switch browsers. Localhost web pages work too.

A separate, free Windows helper is required. On the add-on’s setup page, click Download for Windows, open the downloaded installer and follow the steps. View on GitHub is a separate button for source and release details. Direct download: https://github.com/aspendesign/chrome-hop/releases/latest/download/ChromeHop-Setup-windows-x64.exe . Run it once for your Windows account. No administrator access or runtime downloads are needed. Google Chrome Stable must be installed in its normal Windows location.

Left-click still opens only the current tab immediately. Right-click the toolbar button and choose Open all tabs in this window to open its HTTP(S) tabs in order, keeping Firefox tabs open and skipping unsupported pages.

Chrome Hop uses activeTab, nativeMessaging and menus. The bulk action asks for optional tabs permission to read the selected window’s tab addresses. It queries those addresses only when you choose that menu item. Single-tab opening does not request this permission. It has no content scripts, persistent website permissions, background tab monitoring, history/cookie API, telemetry, background service, custom executable command or shell. The standalone Go helper accepts only one validated HTTP(S) URL.

Privacy: clicking the button sends the selected address to the helper and Chrome on your computer. Mozilla classifies this local transfer as browsing activity. Chrome Hop does not store or log the address or send it to a developer server. Chrome loads the address normally using its own profile and settings; Firefox login sessions and page state are not copied.

Windows 11 x64, Firefox 142+ and Google Chrome Stable. Other operating systems, custom Chrome paths, Beta/Canary and other Chromium browsers are not supported in version 1. Independent open-source project; not affiliated with Mozilla or Google.

privacy_policy.en-US: Chrome Hop sends the clicked tab’s HTTP(S) address to its native helper and installed Google Chrome on the same computer. The right-click Open all tabs in this window option sends that window’s supported tab addresses sequentially, only after optional tabs permission is granted. Other windows are excluded. URLs may contain query strings/tokens. No background tab monitoring, history API, cookies, page content, logging, telemetry or developer-server transfer. Firefox remembers optional permission grants until revoked. Left-click does not request optional tabs access. Chrome loads addresses using its normal profile/history/sync settings; Firefox sessions are not copied. GitHub and Mozilla handle visits/downloads/updates under their policies. Full policy: https://github.com/aspendesign/chrome-hop/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md

version.approval_notes: Windows 11 x64. Version 1.1.0 preserves immediate activeTab left-click opening and adds a toolbar-only menus context: Open all tabs in this window. It calls permissions.request for optional tabs synchronously from that explicit menu gesture, queries only its windowId after approval, skips unsupported URLs and sends sequential single-URL messages to the unchanged strict native helper. No automatic scanning, host permissions, injected scripts, telemetry or network APIs. Permission denial leaves ordinary left-click working. The local URL handoff is disclosed as browsingActivity. Raw extension files are untransformed. Source, tests, threat model and installer: https://github.com/aspendesign/chrome-hop/tree/v1.1.0 . Reproduce on Windows with Go 1.27.3, Node 24.15.0, Inno 7.1.0 and Python 3.11+: python scripts/bootstrap.py; python scripts/build.py. Install the helper from the matching GitHub release. Left-click https://example.com/; Chrome opens it and Firefox stays open. Create two safe web tabs; right-click the action and select Open all tabs in this window, then allow optional tab access. Missing helper shows a packaged direct-download page. Complete source archive accompanies this version.
